10:t_010:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... We can't let them have their way with the Earth we staked our lives to protect.」

10:t_010:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「I won't let it end like this...!」

10:t_010:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... I'll pay you back for this, I swear...!」

10:t_010:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Wash your necks and wait for it. I won't let you do whatever you want with the Earth.」

10:t_010:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So a new battle is about to begin...」

10:t_010:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And one even harsher than any before...」

10:t_010:14.en:
$n
「Even so, all we can do is keep moving forward.」

10:t_010:17.en:
$n
(The enemy I've been chasing... The true $$テンシ$$...)

10:t_100:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「How many more are there...! How many more do I have to shoot down!」

10:t_100:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn...! What do I have to do to save the Earth!!」

10:t_101:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「So the $$ジェミニス$$ we took down were only a tiny part of $$サイデリアル$$!?」

10:t_101:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「These guys...! Just how much force do they have!」

10:t_102:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If this turns into a drawn-out slugfest, we're the ones at a disadvantage...!」

10:t_102:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Crush the enemy's leader, and the battle is over! If we can just find that one...!」

10:t_103:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I mustn't run away... I mustn't run away...」

10:t_104:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$... Do you think we can win?」

10:t_104:1.en:
$$アル$$
「The probability of a tactical victory is 60%. The probability of a strategic victory is...」

10:t_104:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「No, I don't need the rest.」

10:t_104:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Agreed. We have to hit the enemy in front of us first, or nothing else can begin.」

10:t_104:5.en:
$$アル$$
「I've been trained by $c too, after all.」

10:t_105:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「An all-out frontal attack with overwhelming power...! They're not like the $$ジェミニス$$, who came at us with schemes...!」

10:t_105:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Can we win...! Us... the Earth...!」

10:t_106:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why are you attacking the Earth!? What is it you want!?」

10:t_106:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Answer me! What's the point of any of this!」

10:t_107:0.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Please keep watching our rear!」

10:t_107:2.en:
$n
(The one behind these guys must be...!)

10:t_108:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「So you are the new Reactor of the 《$$いがみ合う双子$$》.」

10:t_108:1.en:
$n
「This one...! She's after $$ジェニオン$$'s 《$$スフィア$$》!」

10:t_108:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Do not get conceited. Merely defeating 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》 $$メオンサム$$ is worth nothing to us.」

10:t_108:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Therefore, allow me to carry out my mission.」

10:t_108:4.en:
$n
「Don't give me that nonsense...! I'm not handing my life or the Earth over to you!」

10:t_109:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Miss $$千鳥$$! What do you mean by coming to the command center in the middle of combat...!」

10:t_109:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's all right, $$マデューカス$$. I give my permission.」

10:t_109:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$かなめ$$... Your worry is entirely justified.」

10:t_109:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But we have no intention of retreating. This is our... $c's battle.」

10:t_109:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I understand, $$テッサ$$... I know it's all I can say, but...」

10:t_109:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$宗介$$... everyone... Don't die, no matter what...)

千鳥.evidence: Kaname Chidori's surname (glossary has 千鳥かなめ = Kaname Chidori); Mardukas addresses her as Miss Chidori (ミス・チドリ)

メオンサム.evidence: Surname half of ガドライト・メオンサム = Gadlight Meonsam (glossary); brief text splits the pilot as 《ガドライト》・メオンサム with the keyword link on the first half

kept_omissions: 10:t_010:16: 'Is it waiting beyond this battle...?' - subject of この戦いの先にいるのか left as 'it'; row :17 shows it is the enemy/true Tenshi
10:t_107:2: 'The one behind these guys' - target of the thought left unnamed (as Japanese)
10:t_104:2: 'the rest' - object of the cut-off strategic probability, as Japanese
uncertain: 10:t_107:0: 先生 rendered as 'Ms. $$スズネ$$' (title kept, no honorific); 'Teacher' is the alternative
10:t_108:1: こいつ rendered 'This one... She's' using glossary gender female for Shikoku
10:t_108:2: 《ガドライト》・メオンサム written as 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》 $$メオンサム$$ (keyword link on first half; メオンサム proposed as new name)
10:t_104:5 and 10:t_109:5: $c is the player-named squad, 'trained by $c' / '$c's battle' assumes it reads as a group name
10:t_010:11: 首を洗って待っていやがれ as 'Wash your necks and wait for it' (idiom, threat)
10:t_109:1: 千鳥 proposed as new name for 'Miss Chidori'
10:t_105:1: 俺達は…地球は…! kept as fragments 'Us... the Earth...!'
10:t_010:8: Jeffrey's 生命を懸けて as 'staked our lives to protect'
